event_chain.summary: Network intrusion; personnel files potentially accessed

summary: BBC International LLC, a footwear company, disclosed a breach by unknown external threat actors that potentially compromised personnel files and employment records of current and former employees and consultants, including names, Social Security numbers, dates of birth, government IDs, financial account information, payroll data, health insurance information and medical information from disability or accommodation requests. It began notifying individuals on October 6, 2026 and reported 42 Massachusetts residents to regulators on October 9. It found no evidence the data was actually accessed or exfiltrated.
